title: optimize-nccl-collectives-kvcache-continuous-batching-tp
author: Maya Rao
description: Motivation: Multi-GPU tensor-parallel workloads show suboptimal overlap between NCCL collectives and GPU kernels when KV cache continuous-batching is enabled. Under realistic traffic patterns with many small concurrent requests we observed rising p50 latency and lower sustained throughput. This PR introduces a set of coordinated changes to improve overlap, reduce synchronization stalls, and make continuous batching/kvcache coexistence more robust. Summary of changes: 1) NCCL: introduce a per-tensor-parallel communicator pool and prioritize asynchronous/all-reduce ops on dedicated high-priority streams to reduce blocking on the default stream; tune stream priorities and ordering to ensure kernels can run while collectives progress. 2) Scheduling: rework tp_nccl_scheduler to schedule kernels and collectives with implicit dependencies instead of global sync points; defer non-critical synchronization and prefer cudaEvent-based minimal barriers. 3) KV cache: add prefetch micro-batch that issues KV cache loads ahead of compute for cached prefixes and adapt eviction TTL when continuous batching coalesces requests to reduce cache thrashing. 4) Continuous batching: improve coalescer to form micro-batches with affinity to tensor-parallel ranks and emit batching hints to the scheduler so that kernels and collectives can be aligned. 5) Fallbacks/robustness: add fallback to blocking NCCL path when comm errors are detected and add increased logging and metrics for per-step overlap ratio. Benchmarks: end-to-end tests on 8xA100 (tensor-parallel 8) show ~18% throughput improvement on mixed small/medium prompt workloads and a 12% reduction in p50 latency for 99th-percentile concurrency. Internal perf harness and canary metrics included. Compatibility: no public API changes, runtime-only behavior and config knobs added (tp.nccl.stream_priorities, kvcache.prefetch_microbatch, batching.affinity). Checklist: - [x] Design doc (ENG-4872) linked - [x] Unit tests for scheduler and kvcache prefetch - [x] Integration perf harness runs - [x] Metrics and tracing hooks added - [x] Docs update for new config knobs

release_notes: Performance: ~18% throughput improvement for 8-GPU tensor-parallel setups; ~12% p50 latency reduction under small-batch heavy concurrency. Operational: new runtime knobs (tp.nccl.stream_priorities, tp.nccl.communicator_pool_enabled, kvcache.prefetch_microbatch, batching.affinity). No API or config breaking changes.
